description.value: District Eleven is a Vietnamese-Asian fusion restaurant on Vancouver's Main Street, founded by Chef Phi Le — formerly of New Westminster's Pho Pho You — and built around bold flavours honouring his Vietnamese heritage alongside Japanese and broader East Asian influences. The menu ranges from elevated Vietnamese classics and street-food-inspired appetizers to experimental fusion dishes like Pho Poutine and Aburi Crispy Rice. It describes itself as a restaurant run by cooks for those passionate about food.
